final: WITH t AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM player_award a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY 1), s AS (SELECT hand, tally, tally * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(tally) FROM t) AS share FROM t) SELECT hand, tally, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS excess_over_avg FROM s WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) ORDER BY share DESC
